{{Quote|Years ago, when the Empire became aware of Voss, the Emperor sent the military to lay siege to the planet. The visionaries thwarted what they foresaw to be a simple attempt to conquer.|[[Servant One]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Attack on Voss''' was an event that occurred<ref name="Codex" /> in approximately [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="Voss-Date" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Upon learning that the recently-discovered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] was inhabited by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had powerful [[Force vision/Legends|foresight abilities]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] ordered the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] to conquer the planet.<ref name="Request an Audience" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Khypes]] arrived in orbit with a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] and several [[Army/Legends|army]] divisions in order to demand a surrender, having been alerted that the Voss capital of [[Voss-Ka]] was undefended.<ref name="Codex" />

However, the [[Star Cabal]], a faction that sought to eliminate both the Empire and the Republic, used their advanced technology to override the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]];<ref name="Hidden Throne" /> [[Khypes's battle cruiser|Khypes's cruiser]] exploded before he could contact the planet, and the ship's escorts were destroyed moments later.<ref name="Codex" /> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the agents of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] kidnapped a [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|Voss]] from the surface for the Emperor's [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|own purposes]].<ref name="Request an Audience" /> Realizing that they had underestimated the Voss, the Empire declared that Khypes had gone rogue, and both the Empire and the Republic began making diplomatic overtures to the Voss.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Attack on Voss was first mentioned on the official site of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and it was given a name and further background in the game itself and ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} in-game Codex.
